TriJam 362 – Crack in Reality

Unity Game Jam Platformer

Overview

Created for TriJam 362, a game jam where the goal is to design and build a complete game in just three hours. The theme for the jam was "Crack in Reality".

I developed a simple 2D side-scrolling platformer where the player navigates through a fractured world by traveling between portals that connect different parts of reality.

Gameplay

  • Side-scrolling platformer
  • WASD controls for movement
  • Spacebar to jump
  • Color-matched portals used to traverse the level
  • Objective is to reach the end of the level by navigating the portal network

Tech Stack

  • Unity Game Engine
  • C#
  • Unity Asset Store assets
  • Background music sourced from free YouTube audio

Development Notes

  • Built entirely within the 3-hour TriJam time limit
  • Implemented player movement and jump mechanics
  • Created portal system that teleports players between matching colors
  • Designed a short side-scrolling level that demonstrates the mechanic
